name: Slmod
summary: Server-side multiplayer mod adding admin tools, stats tracking and extra mission-scripting functions.
description: Server hook: the repo's Scripts folder is extracted into Saved Games\DCS (Hooks\slmodGameGUI.lua plus net\Slmod files). Server-only; clients do not need it and it does not run in single player.
